value.0: Welcome, traveler! New to these lands? Ask away - I'll point you the right way.
Getting started - what do you need?
The Wiki at homerslotr.com has nearly everything:
We gather at  discord.gg/VpAtSpe  :
The Donations Chest right here restocks every reboot - and players drop spare gear in it. Check it often!
Recruit henchmen scattered across the module. Each grows stronger as you unlock more - find all 7 for a permanent +1 to every ability score. The Wiki maps them all.
Type  Code:AmuletGift  in chat for a one-time starter amulet.
It has a leveling guide - recommended starting areas and which enemies to fight.
Locate every item, store and creature. Search by type or property, get directions to any area, and see full stats and loot.

See planned and past updates, what's custom vs. stock, and when players are most active - handy for finding a party. In game, your Journal's Completed tab summarizes the server's customizations - the full details live on the Wiki.
All other redeem codes are posted in announcements, plus alerts on updates and scheduled events.
Submit ideas, bugs and exploits to earn Merit - spend it on teleport save-slots and player housing. Vote on others' ideas to help steer the roadmap.

Press J and open the Completed tab - the Server Info journals are your in-game manual, refreshed every login. You'll find: Server Rules, Website, Spells & Magic, Character Progression, Death & Respawn, Appearance & Crafting, Custom Systems, Good/Evil Factions, and Combat & Bosses - soul-fatigue on Heal and boss enrage-on-retreat. Full detail lives on the Wiki at homerslotr.com/manual/Customizations.
